qwen-spark-pi.label: Qwen (Spark, Pi)
qwen-spark-pi.description: Pi against a DGX Spark Qwen3.8-Flash-Next endpoint via LiteLLM. Recommended for 24/7 workers -- open SDK, session/compaction control. Requires a matching entry in ~/.pi/agent/models.json, see docs/custom-providers.md.

qwen-spark-codex.label: Qwen (Spark, Codex)
qwen-spark-codex.description: Codex against a DGX Spark Qwen3.8-Flash-Next endpoint via LiteLLM. Codex speaks the Responses API and runs auxiliary calls Pi does not -- audit before trusting it with unattended, always-on workers.
